questions.q: What does the accelerometer measure in a steady hover?
questions.explain: The accelerometer measures the support reaction force/specific force, not acceleration relative to the ground.

questions.q: A gyro bias of 0.05 °/s, when integrated, gives an angle error per minute of:
What does the 6-position accelerometer calibration calibrate?
questions.explain: Six known orientations give a system of equations for the offsets and scales.

questions.q: In compass calibration, hard iron is:
questions.explain: Hard iron shifts the measurement sphere; soft iron turns it into an ellipsoid.

questions.q: What does VIBE.Clip > 0 mean in ArduPilot?
questions.explain: Clipping means exceeding the sensor's measurement range.

questions.q: Which biases does EKF3 estimate in flight?
questions.explain: Sensor biases are part of the EKF3 state vector.

questions.q: Why does a compass give a wrong heading without knowing roll/pitch?
options: The vertical component of the field leaks into the axes
questions.explain: The large vertical component (inclination up to 70°) projects onto the horizontal axes when tilted.

questions.q: Why does the gyro bias change after power-up?
options: Temperature drift as the board warms up
questions.explain: Temperature drift of 0.01–0.05 °/s per °C: the board warming up shifts the bias.
